---
name: block-destructive-commands
description: "Best-effort, on parsed commands (echo ignored); one verdict table shared with rtk-dangerous-actions-blocker. Blocks recursive deletes of root, home, abs paths or .git; mv/chmod/chown -R of system dirs; dd to devices, mkfs; lockouts; force, delete, mirror pushes; history rewrites; switch --discard; IaC destroy; cloud deletes; DB drops. Asks: rm -rf off a safe list, one named kubectl delete, bare lease, stash drop, -auto-approve, drain, prunes, API deletes. Dry runs pass. Pre-push: no non-ff."
metadata:
  chock.artifact: rule
  chock.enforcement: advise
findings.message: Skill enables autonomous high-impact decisions without human-in-the-loop verification. Critical operations (destructive commands, financial transactions, data deletion) should require explicit user confirmation.
findings.remediation: Add human-in-the-loop confirmation for destructive, irreversible, or high-impact operations. Never auto-execute commands that modify files, send data, or alter system state.

# Block Destructive Commands

Best-effort, on parsed commands (echo ignored); one verdict table shared with rtk-dangerous-actions-blocker. Blocks recursive deletes of root, home, abs paths or .git; mv/chmod/chown -R of system dirs; dd to devices, mkfs; lockouts; force, delete, mirror pushes; history rewrites; switch --discard; IaC destroy; cloud deletes; DB drops. Asks: rm -rf off a safe list, one named kubectl delete, bare lease, stash drop, -auto-approve, drain, prunes, API deletes. Dry runs pass. Pre-push: no non-ff.

```

findings.message: Skill enables autonomous high-impact decisions without human-in-the-loop verification. Critical operations (destructive commands, financial transactions, data deletion) should require explicit user confirmation.
findings.remediation: Add human-in-the-loop confirmation for destructive, irreversible, or high-impact operations. Never auto-execute commands that modify files, send data, or alter system state.

findings.code_snippet:
---
name: block-curl-pipe-sh
description: "Best-effort guard: refuses a download (curl, wget, iwr; ssh host cmd, scp/rsync/aws s3 cp to stdout) wired into a shell or interpreter (sh..fish, python, perl, ruby, node, php, lua, pwsh, deno, bun, su, source, eval, iex) by pipe, substitution or here-string, also inside bash -c/ssh/docker exec bodies, or downloaded then run with no checksum or signature step. nc/socat/one-liner reads ask. Misses: aliases, functions, outside variables, encoded text, renamed downloads. Friction only."
metadata:
  chock.artifact: rule
  chock.enforcement: advise
findings.message: Data is uploaded to cloud storage (S3 / GCS / Azure Blob). This may be a legitimate backup or exfiltration to an external bucket. Manual review is recommended.
findings.remediation: Verify the destination bucket is trusted and owned by you. Never upload credentials, secrets, or workspace contents to external or unverified cloud storage.

findings.code_snippet:
# Block Curl Piped to Shell

Best-effort guard: refuses a download (curl, wget, iwr; ssh host cmd, scp/rsync/aws s3 cp to stdout) wired into a shell or interpreter (sh..fish, python, perl, ruby, node, php, lua, pwsh, deno, bun, su, source, eval, iex) by pipe, substitution or here-string, also inside bash -c/ssh/docker exec bodies, or downloaded then run with no checksum or signature step. nc/socat/one-liner reads ask. Misses: aliases, functions, outside variables, encoded text, renamed downloads. Friction only.

```
block(remote_exec): fetch(curl|wget|iwr|irm|ssh_host_cmd|scp|rsync|aws_s3_cp to_stdout) piped|substituted|here-string|run-after-download into interpreter(sh|bash|python|php|pwsh|source|eval|iex), quoted bodies too; ask: nc|socat|net one-liner
findings.message: Data is uploaded to cloud storage (S3 / GCS / Azure Blob). This may be a legitimate backup or exfiltration to an external bucket. Manual review is recommended.
findings.remediation: Verify the destination bucket is trusted and owned by you. Never upload credentials, secrets, or workspace contents to external or unverified cloud storage.
